title: project-governance-fixture-performance
outOfScope: Changing production invariant behavior or reducing invariant coverage.
Modifying provider configuration or the paused governance-performance-budget implementation.

sources.reason: The existing copied-repository negative tests are the source of the repeated full-quality I/O delay.
Authoritative invariant checker exercised by the affected negative tests.

riskAssessment.reason: The fixture optimization must retain the same invariant checker and negative assertions while eliminating unnecessary whole-tree copies.

reasons: A shared governance test controls the required full-quality execution time.

executionDecision.reason: The root cause and bounded fixture-only correction are locally reproducible and verified.

preReviewWarnings: The optimized fixture must not hide missing-file violations or alter the production invariant checker.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: Negative invariant tests retain their production checker path and missing-file assertions.
The affected fixture no longer copies the complete repository content for each negative case.
Focused tests prove the correction and required full quality remains unchanged.
guidelines: Use a fixture-only optimization; do not change production invariant behavior.
Keep each negative test isolated so file deletion cannot affect the repository under test.

intent.problem: A negative system-invariant test copies the entire repository merely to remove one file, causing repeated strict quality sessions to stall on unrelated I/O.
constraints: Exercise check_system_invariants.invariant_issues without changing its behavior.
Keep the paused parent Work Item and provider configuration untouched.
intent.rationale: A link-backed isolated view preserves read semantics and unlink isolation while making mandatory quality verification proportionate.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Removing the isolated requirements-dev.lock link produces the existing missing-lock issue.
Removing an isolated link does not remove the source repository file.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run the affected negative-test group and inspect the source file.

rawUserRequest: Complete all Work Items efficiently without reducing quality; correct a discovered non-convergent quality workflow before resuming WI-11.

declaredIntent.summary: Remove unnecessary test-fixture I/O while retaining invariant coverage.

restrictedWriteApproval.reason: User explicitly authorized required Contract and governed Work Item writes for this and future Work Items.

rollbackNote: Revert this Work Item diff and restore related tests and docs.
